Name: Travelling Bundles
Author: BlackJack69666
Description:
[color=#d4d4d8]Inspired by the challenge attempted by L Incorporated on youtube, this mod removes the manual effort of finding a suitable seed.[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]When starting a new game, this forces remixed bundles to be enabled and modifies the game seed to be suitable for this challenge.[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]The seed will first be multiplied by ~256 000, and then it will be incremented until it finds one which is compatible with the travelling cart. Note that this causes a short period where the game appears to freeze as it iterates through hundreds of thousands of seeds.[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]The seed is rejected if it produces any of the following bundles:[/color]
[list]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Fish Farmer's[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Quality Fish[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Geologist's[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Treasure Hunter's[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Field Research[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Fodder[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Home Cook's[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Helper's[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Spirit's Eve[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#d4d4d8]In addition, if any of the following bundles are selected, with the corresponding item selected, the seed will also be rejected:[/color]
[list]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Forest – Moss[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Spring Crops – Carrot[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Summer Crops – Summer Squash[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Fall Crops – Broccoli[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Dye – Aquamarine[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#d4d4d8]This results in only bundles that can be completed with the use of the travelling cart being selected.[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8][size=4][b]Challenge Rules[/b][/size][/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]You are free to set your own rules however, this mod has been designed with the following ideas in mind:[/color]
[list]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Other than the starting 500g, all money obtained should come from obtaining items from the travelling cart and processing it in some way, e.g. planting seeds, turning it into wine and so on.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]All items donated to the community center should come from the travelling cart, either directly or by processing items to produce the required items for the community center.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Processing items only includes what you can do on the farm.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#d4d4d8][b]Hard mode:[/b][/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]For extra difficulty, you can follow these harder rules:[/color]
[list]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]All items excluding quality crops or the sweet gem berry must be purchased directly from the travelling cart to be able to donate it to the community center. e.g. if you need a parsnip, you must buy a parsnip, you aren't allowed to buy parsnip seeds and grow it. If you need wine, you must buy it and can't make it from fruit.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]All experience must come from items purchased at the cart, e.g. crops planted and harvested, trees planted and chopped down. To assist with this I recommend using the world_clear Farm removable command, or using multiplayer and playing as a farmhand for the first 4 days to clear the farm, and using a farmhand to clean up any extra debris.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]All machines crafted must be crafted from components bought at the travelling cart.[/color][/*]
[/list][b][size=4]Inspiration/Background[/size][/b]
This was inspired by the challenge attempted by L Incorporated.
In their first attempt, they tried a very manual process of creating saves and checking if they would work for the challenge. However, after generating a considerable number, they decided it would not be practical and so made concessions with the rules.
   [youtube]nXDn4sETypI[/youtube]
After this, using the hard version of the rules, I calculated the probability to be 1 in 297 000, making it impractical to manually search for seeds, but trivial for a computer to quickly find one. For reference, if you created a new game every second (which is the fastest to get a different seed), on average you would get 1 suitable save every ~3.5 days.
With this in mind, I found 12 seeds which would work, which allowed L Incorporated to attempt the challenge again and not make those concesession.
[youtube]b-KQfrAFNd8[/youtube]

To allow everyone to try to play with their own seed, without needing to get help to generate it, I have made this mod which will use the standard seed generation algorithm as a starting point to finding a new seed.

[b][size=4]Mod compatibility[/size][/b]
This mod is likely to have issues with any mod that modifies the game seed.
In addition, it only checks based upon the default remixed bundles and travelling cart availability.
As a result, if you change what is available at the travelling cart, you may not be able to complete the challenge, and it will not change what bundles are chosen.
Likewise, if you modify the bundles, this could either produce a bundle that is invalid for the challenge, or freeze trying to find what it thinks is a valid combination.
